units.body_md: A listing labeled “1,000 followers, affiliate active” only sells you the follower count — TikTok Shop's 2026 eligibility checks the person behind the account: 18+, a verified KTP and bank account, and a clean creator record, per [the rule breakdown](https://seremonia.id/industri/teknologi/beli-akun-tiktok-affiliate-amankah-ini-aturan-tiktok-shop-2026/). The listing hides the account's history, which travels with it: past violations count under the CHR performance rating, and commissions can sit frozen for up to 90 days while under review.
